label: Recruit and equip a unit
notes: Paid assembling cohorts; params request_id mode arm unit_code total source_province source_population_field assembly_town noble_permille commander_id.

label: Train the standing army
notes: Trains existing troops; costs gold and supplies.

label: Issue a battlefield warrant
notes: params: regiment battle_id kind request_id; paid once and revalidated on arrival

label: Assign a unit task
notes: params: request_id regiment battle_id task target_unit formation; player authority and one unit; actual delivery required

label: Send units on an area task
notes: params: request_id kind unit_codes center_x_m center_y_m radius_m known_target_id encounter_policy [task_id for a new revision]; each unit acts on the revision it has received

label: Recall an area task
notes: params: request_id task_id; a recall is a revision delivered like any order

label: Cancel a unit task
notes: params: request_id regiment battle_id; player cancellation takes effect on actual delivery
